_comment: Inline policy for the ECS TASK EXECUTION role (liftoff-api-task-execution).
This role belongs to the ECS agent, not to your application code. It is what
pulls the image, resolves the SSM secrets, and writes logs -- all BEFORE the
container starts. Keep it distinct from the task role: conflating the two is
the most common ECS IAM mistake, and it hands your application permission to
read every secret the agent can reach.
Attach the AWS managed policy AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy as well; it
covers ECR pull and CloudWatch Logs. This inline policy adds only the secret
reads, scoped to the two parameters this service actually needs.
The kms:Decrypt statement is required because the parameters are SecureString.
Even with the default aws/ssm key, the caller needs Decrypt -- omitting it is
why 'ResourceInitializationError: unable to pull secrets' is such a common
first-deploy failure. The ViaService condition means this grant only works
through SSM, not for arbitrary decryption.
Trust policy is in task-role-trust-policy.json (shared with the task role).
